target: STANDING RULE: informative-missingness in Manual Subject Mode dual-measurement
reason: Dropping unmappable items from the logic denominator biases the logic score HIGH (surviving items are the easy/early ones), so the two scores are NOT independent. Logic must be reported as k/n_mappable WITH the mappability fraction shown, plus best/worst bounds (all-unmappable-correct vs all-wrong); flag if mappability correlates with item position/difficulty. Format compliance = 2 numbers (map-rate + drift-point), not 1.

target: Channel contamination experiment — interim result (B admin3 pending, conclusion stable)
reason: A' arm (64 items in ONE API call) decomposed the confounded 14.8-pt API-vs-manual gap. ISOLATION (A per-item 84.4% vs A' blob 100.0%, SAME channel): +15.6 pts, p=1.7e-4.
